source:
@@U04370@@
I pray the magnitude of this great enterprise
will glorify God, but also bring me absolution.
I already feel my spirit being lifted.

@@U04372@@
As Chancellor I must now ask one final formality.

@@U04374@@
A formal deed of transfer, yes—
to the Church.
Bring it and I'll gladly sign.
(The CHANCELLOR-ARCHBISHOP has taken his leave but turns
back at the door.)

@@U04376@@
You will, besides, assign to this work
all of the revenues of said property,
tithes, taxes, payments in kind—
in perpetuity.
Grand sums will be required for proper maintenance,
not to mention administrative costs.
What’s more,
given the desolation of the site,
you will give us gold from your war booty.
It will help to speed the progress.
Ah, yes, and then timber—
not to be overlooked—
timber, lime, and slate and the like
will need transport from distant areas.
The workers, of course, will do that.
The Church will promise blessings
to those who offer use of carts in her service.

@@U04377@@
(Exit.)
translation:
@@U04370@@
我祈祷这个伟大事业的规模
会荣耀上帝，同时也会给我带来赦免。
我已经感觉到我的精神振奋了。

@@U04372@@
作为财政大臣，我现在必须办理最后一项手续。

@@U04374@@
正式的转让契约，是的——
到教会。
把它带来，我很乐意签字。
（大主教已告辞，但转身
回到门口。）

@@U04376@@
此外，您还将分配这项工作
上述财产的所有收入，
什一税、税款、实物付款——
永久。
适当的维护需要巨额资金，
更不用说行政费用了。
更重要的是，
鉴于该地点荒凉，
你将从你的战利品中拿出黄金给我们。
这将有助于加快进展。
啊，是的，然后是木材——
不容忽视——
木材、石灰和板岩等
需要来自遥远地区的运输。
工人们当然会这么做。
教会将许诺祝福
那些为她提供手推车服务的人。

@@U04377@@
（退出。）
